summary: Fixes false-positive nullable-argument errors by preserving explicit @NonNull on type-variable uses when NullAway restores annotations through captured unbounded, extends and super wildcards, copying bounds instead of mutating javac's shared types.

tests.evidence: Bug fix owes regression tests; WildcardTests adds the Caffeine reproducer across five wildcard shapes and a negative-control test for shared-bound mutation. Codecov reports 79% patch coverage (7 lines in TypeSubstitutionUtils uncovered), worth a glance at the untested branches.

doc_comments.evidence: New private helpers carry Javadoc and the visitCapturedType comment was updated for super wildcards; reviewer's only comment asked for a clarifying comment in the test, already applied.

change_description.evidence: Description explains cause, fix and tests; NullAway compiles its changelog at release time.

performance.evidence: Allocates detached wildcard/type-variable copies during type substitution only when a bound changes.

backward_compat.evidence: Removes false positives; explicit bound annotations now take precedence over library-model nullability, which could change results for some users.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial changes to RestoreNullnessAnnotationsVisitor (super wildcards now fall through to the lower bound, non-wildcard counterpart handling, cycle guard generalized) and to precedence of explicit bound annotations in GenericsUtils.wildcardUpperBound.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Explicit @NonNull on a formal upper bound now overrides a library model's @Nullable; stated in the description.

contradictions.evidence: Comments and Javadoc updated alongside the code (UNBOUND -> UNBOUND or SUPER); consistent.

spec_conformance.evidence: Implements JSpecify nullness semantics for wildcard implicit upper bounds and explicit @NonNull on type-variable uses.

plan.why: A focused type-system fix whose correctness, spec and test coverage are best judged together by one reviewer.
